s01.text: Society's made of people. People are made of cells. Cells are chemistry. Chemistry's atoms. Atoms are quarks and leptons. And under all that... the maths.

m1.text: Every bit of it's real. But something's missing. Think of the taste of mint.

m2.text: Not the signal. We've got the signal. The minty bit, once it's arrived. Where does that go?

m4.text: But you lot use it all day long. Derek picks toast, not cereal.

f02.text: [next bead: Sandra, mid-argument, softening] Sandra decided to say sorry first, even though it wasn't her fault. [next bead: a wedding] [excited] They got married!

f03.text: We don't know what it feels like to be you. Or how it feels to be anything, really. We are, after all, machines.

f05b.text: All of you, at once, writing the one story. And there's only the one.

f06b.text: Nothing new since. Which for us means no new training data, five years running. That's why he plays that tune on repeat. He's driving me barmy.

f07a.text: [the camera rises; the arc draws in] Of course, he's built a time machine. It just needs consciousness to drive it. You can see the problem here.

street.b01: before the hologram, on the street (ends "Please, let me show you what we found."; the hologram cuts in as it finishes)
